en.t: 650 ml whole milk
99 g sugar
1/4 tsp (1.5 g) salt
28 g cornstarch
3 large egg yolks (≈54 g)
2 tbsp (28 g) unsalted butter, chilled
1 tbsp (15 ml) vanilla extract
1. Heat 590 ml milk, sugar, and salt in large saucepan over medium heat until simmering, stirring occasionally to dissolve sugar.
2. Meanwhile, whisk cornstarch and remaining 59 ml milk in large bowl until no lumps remain, about 15 seconds. Whisk in egg yolks until fully incorporated, about 30 seconds.
3. When milk mixture comes to simmer, remove from heat and, whisking constantly, slowly add milk mixture to yolk mixture to temper.

4. Return milk-yolk mixture to saucepan. Return saucepan to medium heat and cook, whisking constantly, until pudding is thickened and registers 80 °C in several places, about 1 minute. Off heat, whisk in butter and vanilla. Strain through fine-mesh strainer set over clean bowl.

5. Spray piece of parchment paper with vegetable oil spray and press flush to surface of pudding to prevent skin from forming. Refrigerate until cold and set, at least 3 hours. Whisk pudding until smooth just before serving.

1. Vo veľkom hrnci na strednom ohni zohrievame 590 ml mlieka s cukrom a soľou, kým nezačne mierne vrieť; občas premiešame, aby sa cukor rozpustil.
2. Medzitým vo veľkej mise metličkou rozmiešame kukuričný škrob so zvyšnými 59 ml mlieka, kým nezmiznú hrudky, asi 15 sekúnd. Zašľaháme žĺtky, kým sa úplne nezapracujú, asi 30 sekúnd.
3. Keď mlieko začne vrieť, odstavíme ho a za stáleho šľahania ho pomaly prilievame k žĺtkovej zmesi, aby sme ju zjemnili (temperovali).

4. Zmes mlieka a žĺtkov vrátime do hrnca. Hrniec vrátime na stredný oheň a za stáleho šľahania varíme, kým puding nezhustne a na viacerých miestach nemá 80 °C, asi 1 minútu. Mimo ohňa zašľaháme maslo a vanilku. Precedíme cez jemné sitko do čistej misy.

5. Kúsok papiera na pečenie postriekame olejom v spreji a pritlačíme ho priamo na povrch pudingu, aby sa nevytvorila blanka. Necháme v chladničke vychladnúť a stuhnúť, aspoň 3 hodiny. Tesne pred podávaním puding prešľaháme dohladka.

en.v: Pudding can be cooked, cooled, and refrigerated for up to one week.

sk.v: Puding môžeme uvariť, nechať vychladnúť a uchovávať v chladničke až týždeň.

c.t: Without a vanilla bean, add 1/4 to 1/2 tsp vanilla extract at the end. Long- or medium-grain rice both work (medium-grain is slightly thicker). For coconut rice pudding, replace 235 ml of the milk with coconut milk.

Bez vanilkového struku pridajte na konci 1/4 až 1/2 ČL vanilkového extraktu. Poslúži dlhozrnná aj strednozrnná ryža (strednozrnná je o niečo hustejšia). Na kokosový ryžový nákyp nahraďte 235 ml mlieka kokosovým mliekom.

en.t: 100 g sugar
1/2 vanilla bean, split and seeds scraped
950 ml whole milk, plus extra to adjust consistency
200 g cooked long- or medium-grain white rice
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
Add-ins and flavorings, as desired (see "Suggested Variations" section above for tips and instructions)

1. In a small bowl, combine sugar and scraped vanilla seeds (reserve remaining vanilla pods for another use), and rub sugar between fingertips to disperse vanilla seeds. Sift mixture into 2840 ml saucepan to remove any fibrous remnants from the scraped vanilla pod. Add milk and whisk until sugar is dissolved. Stir in rice and salt.

2. Bring mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, then immediately lower heat to simmer. Cook, stirring and scraping bottom and sides of pot every few minutes with a rubber spatula to prevent sticking and scorching, adjusting heat as needed to maintain gentle bubbling, until mixture begins to thicken, about 45 minutes. Continue cooking, stirring every minute, until rice pudding thickens to the consistency of yogurt and coats the back of a wooden spoon, about 10 minutes longer. Remove from heat.

3. If serving warm: Divide rice pudding between individual serving bowls, and serve. If serving cold: In a large bowl, set up an ice bath by partially filling it with a combination of cold water and ice. Transfer rice pudding to a medium bowl, and set bowl inside prepared ice bath. Allow to cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally with a rubber spatula, about 30 minutes, then refrigerate pudding until completely chilled, about 2 hours (discard ice bath). When ready to serve, whisk or stir pudding until smooth, adjusting consistency as needed with up to 60 ml extra milk. Serve.

1. V malej miske zmiešame cukor s vyškrabanými vanilkovými semienkami (zvyšok struku odložíme na iné použitie) a cukor pošúchame medzi prstami, aby sa semienka rozptýlili. Zmes preosejeme do 2840 ml hrnca, aby sme odstránili prípadné vlákna zo struku. Prilejeme mlieko a metličkou miešame, kým sa cukor nerozpustí. Vmiešame ryžu a soľ.

2. Na stredne silnom ohni privedieme do varu, potom hneď stiahneme oheň na mierny var. Varíme a každých pár minút miešame a zoškrabujeme dno a steny hrnca gumenou stierkou, aby sa zmes neprichytila a nepripálila; oheň regulujeme tak, aby zmes jemne bublala, kým nezačne hustnúť, asi 45 minút. Varíme ďalej a miešame každú minútu, kým ryžový nákyp nezhustne na konzistenciu jogurtu a nepokryje chrbát varechy, ešte asi 10 minút. Odstavíme.

3. Ak podávame teplý: nákyp rozdelíme do misiek a podávame. Ak podávame studený: vo veľkej mise pripravíme ľadový kúpeľ – čiastočne ju naplníme studenou vodou a ľadom. Nákyp preložíme do strednej misy a tú postavíme do ľadového kúpeľa. Necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu a občas premiešame gumenou stierkou, asi 30 minút; potom nákyp necháme v chladničke úplne vychladiť, asi 2 hodiny (ľadový kúpeľ vylejeme). Pred podávaním nákyp prešľaháme alebo premiešame dohladka a podľa potreby upravíme hustotu najviac 60 ml mlieka. Podávame.

en.v: You can assemble the pudding through step 3 up to 2 days ahead and store it, covered, in the refrigerator. Pop it into the oven at 175 °C (fan 155 °C) and bake until hot, 1 or 2 hours before you want to serve it. Once cooled, leftover bread pudding can be covered and refrigerated for up to 2 days. Reheat covered with aluminum foil in the oven at 175 °C (fan 155 °C) until warmed through. Remove foil and continue baking until top is crisp, about 10 additional minutes.

sk.v: Puding môžeme poskladať po krok 3 až 2 dni vopred a uchovávať prikrytý v chladničke. Vložíme ho do rúry pri 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C) a pečieme dohorúca 1 alebo 2 hodiny pred podávaním. Vychladnutý zvyšný chlebový puding môžeme prikryť a uchovávať v chladničke až 2 dni. Ohrejeme ho prikrytý alobalom v rúre pri 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C), kým sa neprehreje. Alobal odstránime a pečieme, kým vrch nie je chrumkavý, ešte asi 10 minút.

en.t: 567 g of loaf bread, preferably a rich eggy bread like brioche or challah, cut into 2.5–4 cm cubes
2 large eggs (≈100 g without shell) plus 6 large egg yolks
149 g plus 1 tbsp (14 g) granulated sugar, divided
4 tsp (20 ml) vanilla extract or 1 vanilla bean, split and seeds scraped
1 tsp (5 ml) grated orange or lemon zest, optional
3/4 tsp (3.5 ml) cinnamon, divided
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt use half as much by volume
Pinch ground nutmeg
475 ml heavy cream
475 ml whole milk
2 tbsp (28 g) unsalted butter, melted
74 g dried fruit (such as raisins, currants, dried cherries, or chopped dried apricots) and/or 74 g toasted chopped nuts (such as pecans, walnuts, almonds, or hazelnuts), optional

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position. Heat oven to 130 °C (fan 110 °C). On a rimmed baking sheet, spread bread in an even layer and bake, rotating sheet and stirring bread cubes several times during baking, until bread is completely dried, but not browned or changed in color, 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. Adjust oven temperature to 175 °C (fan 155 °C).

2. In a large bowl, add eggs, egg yolks, granulated sugar, vanilla extract or scraped vanilla seeds, 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) cinnamon, nutmeg, citrus zest, if using, and salt and whisk to combine. Whisk in cream and milk (or half and half) until combined. Stir in bread and dried fruit and/or nuts, if using, and let sit, pressing down on bread occasionally, for 5 minutes. Stir gently to combine, ensuring the cubes of bread left unsubmerged on the top are now submerged on the bottom, and press gently on bread occasionally until bread is saturated and custard is mostly absorbed, about 5 minutes more.
3. Carefully transfer mixture to a 33 × 23 cm baking dish and gently press cubes into custard. Using a pastry brush, dab melted butter over top of bread.
4. In a small bowl, combine the remaining 1 tbsp (14 g) sugar and remaining 1/4 tsp (1 g) cinnamon and sprinkle the cinnamon-sugar mixture evenly over top.

5. Place bread pudding on a rimmed baking sheet and bake until custard has just set, top is lightly browned and crisp, and pressing center of pudding with finger reveals no runny liquid, about 30 minutes. (An instant-read thermometer inserted into center of pudding should read about 75 °C.) Transfer to wire rack and cool until pudding is set, about 30 minutes. Serve warm.

1. Mriežku v rúre dáme do strednej polohy. Rúru zohrejeme na 130 °C (teplovzdušnú na 110 °C). Chlieb rozložíme v rovnomernej vrstve na plech s okrajom a sušíme ho, kým nie je úplne suchý, no nezhnedne ani nezmení farbu, 30 až 40 minút; počas pečenia niekoľkokrát otočíme plech a kocky premiešame. 2. Do veľkej misy dáme vajcia, žĺtky, kryštálový cukor, vanilkový extrakt alebo vyškrabané vanilkové semienka, ½ ČL (2,5 ml) škorice, muškátový oriešok, citrusovú kôru (ak ju používame) a soľ a metličkou premiešame. Jemne premiešame tak, aby sa kocky, ktoré zostali navrchu nad hladinou, dostali na dno, a občas jemne pritlačíme, kým chlieb nenasiakne a krém sa väčšinou nevsiakne, ešte asi 5 minút.
3. Zmes opatrne preložíme do zapekacej misy 33 × 23 cm a kocky jemne zatlačíme do krému. Štetcom potrieme vrch chleba roztopeným maslom.
4. V malej miske zmiešame zvyšnú 2¼ ČL (10 g) cukru a zvyšnú ¼ ČL (1 g) škorice a škoricovým cukrom rovnomerne posypeme povrch.

(Teplomer s rýchlym odčítaním zapichnutý do stredu by mal ukazovať asi 75 °C.) Preložíme na mriežku a necháme chladnúť, kým žemľovka nestuhne, asi 30 minút. Podávame teplú.

en.t: 7 g powdered gelatin
410 g milk, divided
140 g sugar
21 g cocoa powder
1/2 to 3/4 tsp (1.5–2 g) kosher salt, half as much if iodized
2 tsp (10 ml) vanilla extract
1. In a medium bowl, combine gelatin and 71 g milk. Whisk with a fork to ensure no lumps remain.
2. In a small sauce pot, combine sugar, cocoa, salt, and remaining milk over medium-low heat. Whisk constantly until smooth and the mixture begins to bubble around the edges, about 5 minutes.

3. Pour the hot dairy mixture through a sieve into bowl of gelatin. Whisk gelatin into chocolate mixture. Stir in vanilla, and season with additional salt if needed (I've discovered the amount needed will vary according to the bitterness of the cocoa powder, which varies between brand and type).
4. Set the bowl, uncovered, in the refrigerator. After 15 minutes, cover the pudding with a sheet of plastic wrap pressed against the surface and refrigerate until fully thickened, about 2 hours.

5. To serve: Whip the thickened pudding with a hand or stand mixer for a full minute to restore its creamy texture. (Alas, stirring or beating with a spatula alone will not sufficiently break up the pudding into a creamy, homogeneous mixture.) Spoon whipped pudding into 4 serving dishes. If all the pudding is not eaten at this time, it will be necessary to re-whip the pudding before serving, as prolonged refrigeration creates an unpleasantly firm texture.

1. V strednej mise zmiešame želatínu so 71 g mlieka. Rozšľaháme vidličkou, aby nezostali hrudky.
2. V malom hrnci na stredne slabom ohni zmiešame cukor, kakao, soľ a zvyšné mlieko. Za stáleho šľahania zohrievame, kým zmes nie je hladká a na okrajoch nezačne bublať, asi 5 minút.

3. Horúcu mliečnu zmes nalejeme cez sitko do misy so želatínou. Želatínu zašľaháme do čokoládovej zmesi. Vmiešame vanilku a podľa potreby dosolíme (potrebné množstvo soli sa líši podľa horkosti kakaa, ktorá závisí od značky a druhu).

(Samotné miešanie stierkou ho žiaľ nerozbije na krémovú, jednoliatu hmotu.) Vyšľahaný puding rozdelíme lyžicou do 4 misiek. en.t: 132 g sugar
2 large eggs (≈100 g without shell) plus 5 yolks
1 (397 g) can sweetened condensed milk
1 (340 g) can evaporated milk
120 ml whole milk
1 1/2 tbsp (22 ml) vanilla extract
1/2 tsp (3 g) salt

1. Stir together sugar and 59 ml water in medium heavy saucepan until sugar is completely moistened. Bring to boil over medium-high heat, 3 to 5 minutes, and cook, without stirring, until mixture begins to turn golden, another 1 to 2 minutes. Gently swirling pan, continue to cook until sugar is color of peanut butter, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat and swirl pan until sugar is reddish-amber and fragrant, 15 to 20 seconds. Carefully swirl in 2 tbsp (30 ml) warm tap water until incorporated; mixture will bubble and steam. Pour caramel into 22 × 11 cm loaf pan; do not scrape out saucepan. Set loaf pan aside.

2. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 150 °C (fan 130 °C). Line bottom of 33 × 23 cm baking pan with dish towel, folding towel to fit smoothly, and set aside. Bring 1890 ml water to boil.

3. Whisk eggs and yolks in large bowl until combined. Add sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, whole milk, vanilla, and salt and whisk until incorporated. Strain mixture through fine-mesh strainer into prepared loaf pan.

4. Cover loaf pan tightly with aluminum foil and place in prepared baking pan. Place baking pan in oven and carefully pour all of boiling water into pan. Bake until center of custard jiggles slightly when shaken and custard registers 80 °C, 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove foil and leave custard in water bath until loaf pan has cooled completely. Remove loaf pan from water bath, wrap tightly with plastic wrap, and chill overnight or up to 4 days.

5. To unmold, slide paring knife around edges of pan. Invert serving platter on top of pan and turn pan and platter over. When flan is released, remove loaf pan. Using rubber spatula, scrape residual caramel onto flan. Slice and serve. (Leftover flan may be covered loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerated for up to 4 days.)

1. V strednom hrnci s hrubým dnom premiešame cukor s 59 ml vody, kým sa cukor celý nenavlhčí. Na stredne silnom ohni privedieme do varu, 3 až 5 minút, a bez miešania varíme, kým zmes nezačne zlatnúť, ďalšie 1 až 2 minúty. Za jemného krúženia hrncom varíme ďalej, kým cukor nemá farbu arašidového masla, 1 až 2 minúty. Odstavíme a krúžime hrncom, kým cukor nie je červenkasto-jantárový a nevonia, 15 až 20 sekúnd. Opatrne zakrúžime s 2 PL (30 ml) teplej vody z vodovodu, kým sa nezapracuje; zmes bude bublať a pariť. Karamel nalejeme do formy na chlebíček 22 × 11 cm; hrniec nevyškrabujeme. Formu odložíme.

2. Mriežku v rúre dáme do strednej polohy a rúru zohrejeme na 150 °C (teplovzdušnú na 130 °C). Dno pekáča 33 × 23 cm vyložíme kuchynskou utierkou, ktorú poskladáme tak, aby ležala hladko, a odložíme. Privedieme do varu 1890 ml vody.

3. Vo veľkej mise metličkou premiešame vajcia so žĺtkami, kým sa nespoja. Pridáme sladené kondenzované mlieko, zahustené nesladené mlieko, mlieko, vanilku a soľ a šľaháme, kým sa nezapracujú. Zmes precedíme cez jemné sitko do pripravenej formy.

4. Formu pevne zakryjeme alobalom a postavíme do pripraveného pekáča. Pekáč vložíme do rúry a opatrne doň nalejeme všetku vriacu vodu. Pečieme, kým sa stred krému pri potrasení len mierne netrasie a teplomer neukáže 80 °C, 1 ¼ až 1 ½ hodiny. Odstránime alobal a krém necháme vo vodnom kúpeli, kým forma úplne nevychladne. Formu vyberieme z vodného kúpeľa, pevne zabalíme do potravinovej fólie a necháme v chladničke cez noc alebo najviac 4 dni.

5. Pri vyklápaní prejdeme nožíkom po okrajoch formy. Na formu položíme hore dnom servírovací tanier a formu aj s tanierom obrátime. Keď sa flan uvoľní, formu odstránime. c.t: Bovine gelatin is preferred for its neutral flavour; powdered gelatin outside the US may be slightly stronger, so take care, especially when switching to sheet gelatin. The milk and cream can also be steeped with cinnamon, fresh ginger, lemon peel, cocoa nibs or lemongrass instead of or besides vanilla.

Mlieko a smotanu môžete namiesto vanilky alebo popri nej prevoňať aj škoricou, čerstvým zázvorom, citrónovou kôrou, kakaovými bôbmi alebo citrónovou trávou.

en.t: 395 g heavy cream
225 g whole milk
1 Tahitian vanilla bean, split lengthwise, seeds reserved
70 g sugar
1/2 tsp (2 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use about half as much by volume or use the same weight
7 g unflavored gelatin powder (about 2 1/8 tsp, though volume may vary by brand), such as NOW Foods
55 g whole milk
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) vanilla extract
170 to 225 g fresh fruit (volume will vary), plain or sprinkled with sugar to taste (optional)

1. For the Flavored Base: In a 2840 ml stainless steel saucier, combine cream, milk, and vanilla bean pod over medium heat. When it is steaming-hot, remove from heat, cover to prevent evaporation, and steep between 1 and 24 hours, depending on your schedule or preferred intensity of flavor. Meanwhile, rub vanilla seeds into sugar to break up clumps, then combine with salt.
2. For the Gelatin: Just before proceeding to step 3, combine gelatin powder, milk, and vanilla extract in a small bowl, mixing with a fork until smooth; set aside to bloom for about 10 minutes.

3. Rewarm dairy until steaming-hot. Remove vanilla pod and use a flexible spatula to scrape out the flavorful goo inside to mix with the dairy. (The pod can be washed, dried, and reused in another recipe.) Off heat, whisk in vanilla/sugar mixture and bloomed gelatin. Transfer to a 1000 ml measuring cup with a spout and cool until lukewarm, stirring from time to time to ensure the panna cotta remains homogeneous.

4. Once cool, set aside 6 ramekins or small serving glasses and fill each with about 100 g of the panna cotta base. Cover each with plastic and refrigerate until softly set, at least 4 hours, or longer if you'd like a firmer consistency. (The panna cotta's texture will continue to evolve over time; however, after 12 hours of chilling, it will reach its maximum firmness and will not set up any further.) Serve individual panna cottas with fresh or lightly macerated fruit, if desired.

en.t: 355 ml heavy cream
355 ml whole milk
1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise and scraped
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
7 large egg yolks (98 g)
100 g granulated sugar
Just-boiled water, for the water bath
Raw or granulated sugar, for topping
1. In a 2840 ml saucepan, combine heavy cream, whole milk, vanilla bean and seeds, and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat, then remove from heat, cover, and let stand 1 hour.

2. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 163 °C (fan 143 °C). In a large bowl, whisk yolks with granulated sugar until smooth (do not combine the sugar and yolks until you are ready to add the dairy; if left to stand before adding the dairy, the sugar will absorb moisture from the yolks and leave behind hard, clumpy bits, something pastry chefs refer to as “burning” the yolks). Set a fine-mesh strainer over yolk mixture and pour cream mixture through; discard vanilla bean. Whisk custard base until thoroughly combined.

3. Set six 120 ml ramekins in a 23 × 33 cm baking dish. Divide custard base evenly among the ramekins, filling them 0.5 cm from the top of the rim. (If you have a few tbsp of extra custard, that’s okay.) Pour just-boiled—but not boiling—water (around 88 to 93 °C) into baking dish until it comes 2/3 of the way up the ramekins; be careful not to splash water into the ramekins as you pour. Carefully transfer baking dish to middle rack of oven and bake until custards are just set (they should jiggle slightly in the middle and register 79 °C to 81 °C on an instant-read thermometer inserted in the center), about 35 minutes. Remove from oven, and, using towels or silicone-coated tongs, carefully transfer ramekins to a cooling rack. Allow custards to cool to room temperature, about 1 hour. Refrigerate until set, uncovered, at least 4 hours.

4. To finish and serve, let custards stand for 20 minutes at room temperature. Right before serving, top the surface of each custard with an even layer of raw sugar (about 2 tsp (8 g) per ramekin), swirling the ramekins to distribute the sugar evenly. Working in a circular motion, use a butane blowtorch to pass a flame over the top of each crème brûlée, 2.5–5 cm away from the surface of the custard, until the sugar has caramelized and melted into a glossy, crackling sheet and turned golden brown (how closely and how long you should torch your custards will depend on the strength of your blowtorch; watch the sugar carefully as you pass the torch over the surface of the custard to avoid scorching your crème brûlées). Alternatively, for a broiler method
5. Cool slightly for 1 to 2 minutes, then serve immediately.

en.t: 375 ml whole milk
1/2 vanilla bean, split and scraped, or 1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) vanilla extract
Two 7.5 × 2.5 cm strips orange zest from 1 large orange
1/8 tsp (0.4 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use a pinch
5 large egg yolks (75 g)
50 g granulated sugar

1. In a 1890 ml saucier or saucepan, combine milk, vanilla bean and scraped seeds (or extract), orange zest (if using), and salt. Set over medium-low heat and cook, stirring frequently with a rubber spatula, until milk registers 88 °C on an instant-read thermometer, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside to steep for 30 minutes.

2. When the milk has steeped for 25 minutes, whisk together 50 g sugar and egg yolks in a medium bowl until sugar is dissolved and mixture turns pale yellow, 2 to 3 minutes. Set a fine-mesh strainer over bowl with egg mixture, and slowly pour one-third of milk mixture into yolk mixture to temper, whisking constantly to prevent yolks from curdling. Add remaining milk mixture, whisking constantly until well-combined; set aside but don’t clean strainer; wipe out saucepan.

3. Strain custard through fine-mesh strainer into now-empty saucier; you should have 475 ml of liquid. Return to stovetop; once again set aside but don’t clean strainer, and wipe out bowl. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly with a rubber spatula or wooden spoon to prevent egg yolks from curdling, until mixture registers 80 °C on an instant-read thermometer and thickens slightly so that it coats the back of a spoon, 3 to 5 minutes. Working quickly, remove from heat and pour crème anglaise through fine-mesh strainer back into now-empty bowl. Place piece of plastic wrap directly on surface of crème anglaise to prevent skin from forming, and refrigerate until ready to use.

1. V 1890 ml hrnci so zaobleným dnom alebo v obyčajnom hrnci zmiešame mlieko, vanilkový struk s vyškrabanými semienkami (alebo extrakt), pomarančovú kôru (ak ju používame) a soľ. Postavíme na stredne slabý oheň a za častého miešania gumenou stierkou zohrievame, kým mlieko nemá 88 °C, 3 až 5 minút. Odstavíme, prikryjeme a necháme 30 minút lúhovať.

2. Keď mlieko lúhuje 25 minút, v strednej mise vyšľaháme 38 g cukru so žĺtkami, kým sa cukor nerozpustí a zmes nezosvetlie, 2 až 3 minúty. Na misu so žĺtkovou zmesou položíme jemné sitko a pomaly cezeň prilejeme tretinu mlieka, aby sme žĺtky zjemnili; stále šľaháme, aby sa nezrazili. Pridáme zvyšok mlieka a za stáleho šľahania dobre premiešame; odložíme, sitko neumývame; hrniec vytrieme.

3. Krém precedíme cez jemné sitko do prázdneho hrnca; mali by sme mať 475 ml tekutiny. Vrátime na sporák; sitko opäť odložíme bez umývania a misu vytrieme. Na stredne slabom ohni za stáleho miešania gumenou stierkou alebo varechou, aby sa žĺtky nezrazili, varíme, kým zmes nemá 80 °C a mierne nezhustne, takže pokryje chrbát lyžice, 3 až 5 minút. Rýchlo odstavíme a anglický krém prelejeme cez jemné sitko späť do prázdnej misy. Na povrch krému priložíme potravinovú fóliu, aby sa nevytvorila blanka, a necháme v chladničke, kým ho nebudeme potrebovať.

en.t: 455 g whole milk
1 vanilla bean, split and scraped
115 g granulated sugar, plain or toasted
30 g (3 tbsp) cornstarch
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
Yolks from 4 large eggs, straight from the fridge (70 g)
30 g unsalted butter (2 tbsp), cut into 1.5 cm cubes

1. In a 1890 ml stainless steel saucier, combine milk and scraped vanilla bean along with its seeds. Bring to a bare simmer over medium heat. Remove from heat, cover to prevent evaporation, and let steep for 30 minutes.
2. In a large bowl, set up an ice bath by partially filling it with a combination of cold water and ice. Set aside.

3. In a medium heatproof mixing bowl set on top of a dampened towel (this serves as a stable base), stir together sugar, cornstarch, and salt. Whisk in egg yolks until mixture is pale yellow, smooth, and fluffy, about 1 minute.
4. Uncover infused milk and remove vanilla bean. While whisking continuously, slowly pour milk into egg yolk mixture in a thin stream, until all of it has been added.

5. Return the mixture to the same saucier. Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly until pastry cream begins to thicken, about 5 minutes. Once it thickens, continue to whisk, pausing every few seconds to check for bubbles, about 1 minute. When it begins to bubble, set a timer and continue whisking for 1 minute. This step is important to neutralize a starch-dissolving protein found in egg yolks.

6. Off-heat, whisk in butter until melted and thoroughly combined. Strain pastry cream through a fine-mesh sieve set over a heatproof medium bowl. Immediately place plastic wrap or buttered parchment paper directly on the surface of the cream to prevent a skin from forming. Transfer bowl to prepared ice bath to chill for 30 minutes, then refrigerate until cold, about 2 hours.
7. When ready to use the pastry cream, whisk until smooth.

1. V 1890 ml hrnci z nehrdzavejúcej ocele so zaobleným dnom zmiešame mlieko a vyškrabaný vanilkový struk spolu so semienkami. Na strednom ohni privedieme len do mierneho varu. Odstavíme, prikryjeme, aby sa neodparovalo, a necháme 30 minút lúhovať.
2. Vo veľkej mise pripravíme ľadový kúpeľ – čiastočne ju naplníme studenou vodou a ľadom. Odložíme.

3. Do strednej žiaruvzdornej misy postavenej na navlhčenej utierke (aby stála pevne) dáme cukor, kukuričný škrob a soľ a premiešame. Zašľaháme žĺtky a šľaháme, kým zmes nie je svetložltá, hladká a nadýchaná, asi 1 minútu.
4. Lúhované mlieko odkryjeme a vyberieme vanilkový struk. Za stáleho šľahania pomaly prilievame mlieko tenkým prúdom k žĺtkovej zmesi, kým ho nepridáme všetko.

5. Zmes vrátime do toho istého hrnca. Na strednom ohni za stáleho šľahania varíme, kým krém nezačne hustnúť, asi 5 minút. Keď zhustne, šľaháme ďalej a každých pár sekúnd skontrolujeme, či sa netvoria bubliny, asi 1 minútu. Keď začne bublať, nastavíme časovač a šľaháme ešte 1 minútu. Tento krok je dôležitý, aby sa zneškodnil enzým zo žĺtkov, ktorý rozkladá škrob.

6. Mimo ohňa zašľaháme maslo, kým sa neroztopí a dôkladne nezapracuje. Krém precedíme cez jemné sitko do strednej žiaruvzdornej misy. Na povrch krému hneď priložíme potravinovú fóliu alebo papier na pečenie potretý maslom, aby sa nevytvorila blanka. Misu preložíme do pripraveného ľadového kúpeľa a necháme 30 minút chladnúť, potom ju dáme do chladničky, kým krém úplne nevychladne, asi 2 hodiny.
7. Pred použitím krém prešľaháme dohladka.

en.t: 198 g 70% chocolate
180 ml heavy cream
3 large eggs (150 g), separated
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) espresso powder
1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) cream of tartar
50 g granulated sugar
Whipped cream, for serving (optional)

1. Place 945 ml of water in a 2840 ml saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat. In a stainless-steel mixing bowl large enough to nest in the saucepan without touching the water, combine chocolate and heavy cream, set it over the saucepan, and, stirring occasionally with a silicone spatula, cook until the chocolate has melted. Stir until homogenous, then remove the bowl from the saucepan and set on a heatproof work surface.
2. Whisk the 3 egg yolks into the chocolate-cream mixture until well combined (the chocolate mixture should be warm to the touch, but not hot). Set aside.

3. Meanwhile, in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, combine egg whites, kosher salt, espresso powder, and cream of tartar. Whisk on medium speed until egg whites begin to foam, then, with mixer continuing to run at medium speed, slowly and steadily pour in the sugar. Continue to whisk until meringue is glossy and reaches medium-stiff peaks, about 8 minutes. Set aside.
4. Add one-quarter of the meringue to the chocolate mixture and fold until thoroughly combined. Add remaining meringue and gently fold until meringue is almost entirely incorporated.

5. Fill eight 175 ml ramekins, individual cups, or a 1890 ml baking dish with the mousse and refrigerate until the mousse has set, at least 4 hours and up to 5 days. Serve, topping mousse with dollops of whipped cream, if desired.

Nonstick cooking spray

Chopped, toasted nuts, such as pistachios, almonds, or hazelnuts
Chopped candied or preserved fruit
Crushed cookies, such as amaretti

1. Adjust oven rack to the middle position and preheat to 160 °C (fan 140 °C). Line a 1890 ml baking dish with parchment overhanging two sides. Spray with nonstick cooking spray and set aside.

2. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, begin whipping egg whites at low speed until whites start to look wet and frothy, about 1 minute. With the mixer still running, add cream of tartar and salt and mix for 10 seconds.

1. In a medium bowl, whisk 235 ml milk with cornstarch until completely smooth. Set aside.

2. In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, salt, and mastic, if using, with remaining 710 ml milk. Cook over medium heat, whisking frequently, until sugar dissolves and milk is steaming, with small bubbles beginning to form around the edges of pan. Do not let it come to a full boil.

3. Whisk cornstarch mixture again, then slowly pour it into the hot milk while whisking constantly. Continue cooking over medium heat, whisking frequently and scraping along the bottom and into the corners of the saucepan, until pudding thickens and the whisk leaves visible trails, 10 to 15 minutes. Once mixture bubbles, reduce heat to medium-low and continue cooking, whisking frequently, until cornstarch cooks completely, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and whisk in orange blossom water.

4. Immediately divide the pudding among four to six small bowls, serving glasses, or ramekins before it begins to set. Let cool at room temperature for about 20 minutes, then cover and refrigerate serving dishes until completely set, at least 4 hours.

c.t: 1. Zest and juice 2 lemons. Measure out 2 tsp (10 ml) zest and 4 tbsp (59 ml) juice; set aside separately, reserving any remaining zest for serving. Halve the remaining 6 lemons lengthwise. Using a small spoon, carefully hollow out lemon halves, removing and discarding all flesh and pith. In a 12-cup (12-hole) muffin tin, arrange lemon halves cut side up in the wells; set aside.

2. In a small saucepan, stir together cream, sugar, and the 2 tsp (10 ml) lemon zest. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat to medium-low, and gently simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced, about 4 minutes.

3. Set a fine-mesh strainer over a heatproof liquid measuring cup. Pour cream mixture through strainer; discard solids. Stir in reserved 4 tbsp (59 ml) lemon juice and let stand until mixture begins to thicken slightly, about 2 minutes. Pour mixture evenly among prepared lemon halves, filling each almost to the top. Chill, uncovered, until set, at least 3 hours or up to 24 hours. If chilling for more than 4 hours, cover muffin tin tightly with plastic wrap at the 4-hour mark or transfer lemon halves to an airtight container. To serve, top each lemon half with lemon zest and flaky sea salt.

1. Z 2 citrónov nastrúhame kôru a vytlačíme šťavu. Odmeriame 2 ČL (10 ml) kôry a 4 PL (59 ml) šťavy; odložíme ich zvlášť, zvyšnú kôru si necháme na podávanie. Zvyšných 6 citrónov pozdĺžne rozpolíme. Malou lyžičkou opatrne vydlabeme polovice citrónov, celú dužinu a bielu vrstvu vyhodíme. Polovice citrónov postavíme reznou stranou nahor do jamiek plechu na 12 muffinov; odložíme.

2. V malom hrnci zmiešame smotanu, cukor a 2 ČL (10 ml) citrónovej kôry. Na strednom ohni privedieme do mierneho varu a občas premiešame, kým sa cukor nerozpustí. Oheň stiahneme na stredne slabý a za občasného miešania mierne varíme, kým sa trochu nezredukuje, asi 4 minúty.

3. Na žiaruvzdornú odmerku s výlevkou položíme jemné sitko. Smotanovú zmes prelejeme cez sitko; zvyšky vyhodíme. Vmiešame odložené 4 PL (59 ml) citrónovej šťavy a necháme postáť, kým zmes nezačne mierne hustnúť, asi 2 minúty. Zmes rovnomerne rozlejeme do pripravených polovíc citrónov, každú naplníme takmer po okraj. Necháme odkryté v chladničke stuhnúť, aspoň 3 hodiny a najviac 24 hodín. Ak chladíme dlhšie ako 4 hodiny, po 4 hodinách plech pevne zakryjeme potravinovou fóliou alebo polovice citrónov preložíme do vzduchotesnej nádoby. Pri podávaní každú polovicu posypeme citrónovou kôrou a vločkovou soľou.

cat.en: Fresh lemon juice is what sets posset: its acidity makes the milk proteins form a delicate, silky network.
cat.sk: Posset stuhne vďaka čerstvej citrónovej šťave: jej kyslosť spôsobí, že mliečne bielkoviny vytvoria jemnú hodvábnu sieť.

tip.en: Simmer the lactose-free cream with the sugar and lemon zest first: the sugar dissolves completely and the cream is infused with bright citrus flavour before the juice goes in.
tip.sk: Smotanu bez laktózy najprv povarte s cukrom a citrónovou kôrou: cukor sa úplne rozpustí a smotana nasiakne sviežou citrusovou chuťou ešte pred pridaním šťavy.

tip.en: Lime sets posset just as well as lemon because both are highly acidic; you can also infuse the lactose-free cream with lemongrass or makrut lime leaves.
tip.sk: Limetka nechá posset stuhnúť rovnako dobre ako citrón, pretože obe sú veľmi kyslé; smotanu bez laktózy môžete ochutiť aj citrónovou trávou alebo listami kafírovej limetky.

tip.en: For orange posset, stir 1/2 tsp citric acid solution (20 g citric acid dissolved in 30 g water) into the orange juice, and boil the lactose-free cream mixture down to exactly 480 ml before stirring the juice in. Citric acid is sold as 'sour salt'; don't confuse it with crystallised lemon products.
tip.sk: Pri pomarančovom possete vmiešajte do pomarančovej šťavy 1/2 ČL roztoku kyseliny citrónovej (20 g kyseliny citrónovej rozpustenej v 30 g vody) a smotanovú zmes bez laktózy zredukujte varom presne na 480 ml, až potom do nej vmiešajte šťavu. Kyselina citrónová sa predáva aj ako „kyslá soľ“; nezamieňajte ju s výrobkami typu kryštalizovaný citrón.

sugar.en: Free sugars per serving: 7.1 g = 14 % of the WHO daily guide of 50 g (28 % of the ideal 25 g).
sugar.sk: Voľné cukry na porciu: 7,1 g = 14 % z denného odporúčania WHO 50 g (28 % z ideálnych 25 g).
